name: Planetkiller Launch Site
desc:
The infrastructure and pagentry necessary for the greatest bluff the Persean Sector has ever seen, this network of secret blacksites and manufacturing facilities allows a Planetkiller Device to be assembled into a DISPP-974C Interfector Missile in orbit. While the Planetkiller Device within is functionally inert without the necessary arming codes, the general populace and the leadership of most major factions have no way of confirming these codes are lost. A dedicated team of analysts, envoys and propagandists help to ensure that reasonable doubt will always exist around the utility of our device.

The memory of Opis and Hanan Pacha both inspire and terrify irrespective of which end of the weapon you are on, but to our populace the knowledge that we uniquely have the power to sunder a world will hopefully be a comforting and unifying prospect, the immense show of force surely discouraging hostile actions against our faction, economically or militarily.

name: Burechiri Park
desc:
Headquarters of the Flowerfish Network, the near-sovereignty granted to the Burechiri Park Complex is a testament to the organisations unnerving power over the local administration. 

Connected to wider Ailmarene society by a dedicated transit line and private spaceport, Burechiri Park is sequestered comfortably beside the Numeran Sea, one of Ailmars frozen oceans. The blueprints are shockingly easy to unearth on the holo-net, and imply the majority of the Complex is beneath the surface. The complex notably hosts a number of greenhouses and an artificial lake, kept within Terran temperature ranges at some expense.

Successful, influential and with access to the best equipment credits can buy, the Flowerfish are a ferocious and well respected mercenary outfit.
